business_problem: Solar Coca-Cola's finance team was gathering data from many internal sources and running spreadsheet-based simulations manually, which could not keep up with the complexity created by acquisitions, decentralized decision-making, and the need for granular margin analysis.
solution_summary: Solar Coca-Cola partnered with CTI Global to replace spreadsheet-heavy reporting with an integrated planning environment built on IBM Planning Analytics and connected to its IBM Cognos Analytics platform. CTI helped the finance team decide which data elements and simulation views were needed for pricing, margin, profit, and cash-flow decisions across Solar's 18 state-level business units. Planning Analytics became the modeling engine for scenario testing and continuous integrated planning, while Cognos remained the reporting layer for distributing tailored views to decision-makers. The team also designed dashboards and trained Solar's staff on business rules so the finance organization could maintain and adapt the models itself. The resulting architecture gives executives and local planners a single source of truth with near-real-time, customer-level insight instead of slow spreadsheet cycles.

solution_components.name: IBM Planning Analytics
solution_components.role: Runs Solar's granular financial simulations, planning models, and scenario analysis across decentralized business units.

solution_components.name: IBM Cognos Analytics
solution_components.role: Provides the reporting interface that distributes tailored financial views and dashboards to decision-makers.

data_flow: Financial inputs from Solar's internal sources are consolidated into Planning Analytics for simulation and integrated planning, then surfaced through Cognos reports and dashboards so finance leaders and state-level managers can act on current margin, pricing, and profitability data.
business_outcome: Solar freed significant finance capacity, increased reporting output without adding headcount, and gave managers faster, deeper insight for pricing and planning decisions across the business.
